_about: Hand-written mapping from each run's generated field names and enum values to the labeled expected ones (fixtures/eval/policies/consumer-lending/expected.ruleset.json). null means no counterpart.

age.why: applicant's age at application (p1), the same quantity as expected age

repayment_term_months.why: repayment term in months (p2), expected term_months

employment_status.why: employment status enum salaried/self-employed/retired/unemployed (p3), expected employment_type

current_employment_tenure_months.why: months at the current employer (p3); expected employment_months is 'tenure at current workplace, or months active as self-employed'

self_employment_tenure_months.why: months active as self-employed (p3); expected employment_months covers it

has_stable_income.why: 'stable income' (p4) is not an input in the label; the label handles it with the flag R-420, so no counterpart

monthly_net_income.why: net monthly income, 12-month average for self-employed (p4), expected monthly_income

existing_monthly_repayments.why: total existing monthly repayments (p6), expected existing_monthly_debt

negative_credit_events_last_24_months.why: count of negative credit events in 24 months (p7), expected credit_events_24m

has_guarantor.why: whether a guarantor is provided (p7), expected has_guarantor

monthly_installment.why: derived Spitzer installment at 9% (p5), expected derived monthly_installment

debt_to_income_ratio.why: derived (existing + installment) / income (p6), expected derived debt_to_income

loan_end_age.why: derived age at the end of the term (p8); the label has no such field (R-116 inlines 78 - term/12)
